title: The nation’s largest school districts consider ditching Google Search
summary: New York, Los Angeles, and Chicago schools are considering Google alternatives after the company said it will disable Search for schools that opt out of its AI features, according to The New York Times. Starting next year, schools will not have the option to disable Gemini-powere
reason: Item reports school districts weighing Google alternatives after Google ties Search access to its AI features.
